tools.name: get_account_console_kit
tools.description: JSON kit to write a local novence-console.html: snapshot, HTML template, session mint instructions. Serve on localhost.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "list_files" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "get_file" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, get_preview_url, create_account_session, get_account_console_kit · Private data: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, list_files, get_file, delete_file, create_account_session · Public sink: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, deploy, create_form, update_form · Destructive: delete_file, deploy, run_checks, delete_form_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, get_preview_url, create_account_session, get_account_console_kit · Private data: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, list_files, get_file, delete_file, create_account_session · Public sink: get_upload_url, get_upload_urls_batch, confirm_upload, confirm_uploads_batch, deploy, create_form, update_form · Destructive: delete_file, deploy, run_checks, delete_form_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
